trades.name: Fail/LAAF of 7566-7569
trades.quote: Short a fail or LAAF of 7566-7569 (especially if NQ is showing corresponding weakness) targeting 53 (honorable mention), 7540, and 27-31. Monitor for continuation to (and potentially through) 7509-7515 but I would plan to be well-covered here and open to flipping long. A/A- rating.

trades.name: Hold of 7540 / 7527-7531 (sellers can't get through)
trades.quote: If sellers can’t get through 7540 and 7527-7531 then Tuesday and Wednesday’s buyers are reasonably comfortable, and Thursday’s sellers are quite uncomfortable. I therefore have to be willing to look for longs in alignment with the session trend and profile if either area is holding. B/B-

trades.name: Hold/LBAF of 7509-7515

trades.name: Long in 7490-7493
trades.quote: Getting long in the 7490-7493 (maybe as high as 97 from last week) range feels a bit risky and would look pretty ugly, but higher time frame buyers can certainly step in and mitigate any weakness here so I’ll remain open to it with a B/B+ rating.

trades.name: LBAF of Thursday's 7479.5 low
trades.quote: Long a LBAF of Thursday’s 7479.5 low. Like the above, this would look terrible if seen but imagine sellers exert a ton of effort to unwind the ETH float higher only to get stuffed a few handles below Thursday’s low in the 7472-7476 range. If I were a seller I would be pretty demoralized and could see covers coming in to trigger reclaims of 7490-7493 and 7509-7515. B rating

The 7598-7604 range is quite critical so it must remain valid. We know from the weekly plan that sellers would have to get through 7566-7569 for it to have bearish potential. B- rating,
